name: Cut-And-Thrust
description: The weapon can deal either {{damage.slashing}} or {{damage.piercing}} damage.

name: Nimble
description: Dexterity can be used to provide the weapon’s damage, instead of strength.

name: Improvised
description: The item is not designed as a weapon. The damage die is rolled with disadvantage.

name: Light
description: The weapon can be used alongside a greatshield, or dual wielded alongside another light weapon.

name: Two-Handed
description: The weapon must be handled with two hands when attacking.

name: Sharp
description: The critical threshold for the weapon is reduced by 1. This ability is lost after critical failing an attack roll, but can be regained by using a whetstone.

name: Polearm
description: The weapon can hit targets 10 feet away instead of 5, and is compatible with the Polarm Charge ability.

name: Throwable
description: The weapon does not gain the {{weapon_keywords.improvised}} trait when thrown.

name: Crossbow
description: The weapon is a mechanical crossbow. It requires 30 seconds to reload, and its damage does not benefit from the user's attribute scores.

name: Firearm
description: The weapon is a firearm and deals {{damage.force}} damage. It requires 1 minute to reload, and its damage does not benefit from the user's attribute scores.

name: Parrying
description: The weapon increases mitigation by the indicated amount when the parry reaction is taken.

name: Blocking
description: The weapon increases BC by a certain amount, doubled when actively blocking.

name: Mordhau
description: The weapon can be held by the blade, using the crossguard as a hammer. This changes the weapon’s damage type to bludgeoning, and replaces the damage die. (Larger swords have this property.)

name: Versatile
description: The weapon can be held in an alternate grip for extra damage.

name: Projectile
description: The weapon fires a specific type of projectile

name: Ranged
description: The weapon has a range: X/Y. Attacks against targets beyond X feet away have disadvantage; attacks against targets beyond Y feet away automatically fail.
